viewers.title: Active viewers
viewers.explanation: Counts the browsers and apps watching a stream from go2rtc, such as a browser on the Live page, Home Assistant or VLC. Each viewer is one browser or app on one address, so a Live dashboard playing several cameras counts once, and the line below says how many streams the viewers play and over which protocol.
viewers.explanationNotCounted: Frigate's own detect, record and audio readers and go2rtc's transcoders connect over RTSP from this machine, so they are not counted, and neither is a WebRTC session until it connects.
viewers.explanationLimits: Two people behind the same proxy, using the same browser, look like one viewer. Cameras Frigate reads directly, not through go2rtc, are not seen, so someone watching only those is not counted.
viewers.unavailable: The list of go2rtc readers is not available.
viewers.none: Nobody is watching a live stream
viewers.unseen: No camera goes through go2rtc, so viewers are not seen
